properties.description: Telling Shots and Firefight Fumbles for Traveller (Mongoose 2E): boxcars on an attack rolls a Telling Shot, snake eyes a Firefight Fumble (unless the ruleset's Combat Mishaps option is on, which rolls the book's mishap table). Results go to chat for the Referee with tracker reminders.
